title: India's OTT Scorecard: The 10 Most-Watched Shows of 2026 So Far
excerpt: Jim Sarbh's Made In India tops scripted charts with 17.8 million views while Samay Raina's India's Got Latent becomes the most-watched OTT property of the year at 38.5 million, according to Ormax Media.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Samay Raina's India's Got Latent Season 2 leads all OTT content with 38.5 million views.
  • Jim Sarbh's Made In India tops scripted shows with 17.8 million views in 2026.
  • Amazon Prime Video secured six of the top 10 scripted shows, dominating the rankings.
  • JioHotstar's Chiraiya ranks second with 16.3 million views, showcasing audience demand for social dramas.
  • Netflix's Taskaree is the only scripted entry in the top 10, with 14.2 million views.
  • Jim Sarbh's Made In India: A Titan Story topped India's OTT charts with 17.8 million views in the first half of 2026, according to the Ormax StreamView Report.
  • Amazon Prime Video dominated the top 10 scripted shows list with five entries, while JioHotstar claimed three spots and Netflix managed just one.
  • Across all OTT content including unscripted shows, Samay Raina's India's Got Latent Season 2 was the single most-watched property with 38.5 million views, surpassing even Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar.

Made In India Leads India's Streaming Charts

The Ormax StreamView Report for January–June 2026 is out, and the numbers reveal a decisive shift in what Indian audiences are watching. Amazon MX Player's biographical drama Made In India: A Titan Story — starring Jim Sarbh as Xerxes Desai in the story of the Titan Company — claimed the top spot among scripted shows with 17.8 million views, according to data released by Ormax Media.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=D1J2zKsOL2o

The series, which traces the rise of one of India's most recognizable watch and jewellery brands, resonated with viewers drawn to its mix of corporate drama and national pride. Its success signals a growing appetite for homegrown biographical content on streaming platforms.

The Full Top 10: Scripted Shows

The complete ranking of the most-viewed scripted series on Indian OTT platforms from January to June 2026, based on Ormax Media's official data:

1. Made In India: A Titan Story — 17.8 million views (Amazon MX Player)
2. Chiraiya — 16.3 million views (JioHotstar)
3. Taskaree — 14.2 million views (Netflix)
4. Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar Season 2 — 12.6 million views (JioHotstar)
5. Matka King — 12.1 million views (Prime Video)
6. Gram Chikitsalay Season 2 — 10.2 million views (Prime Video)
7. Aspirants Season 3 — 9.7 million views (Prime Video)
8. Ab Hoga Hisaab — 9.3 million views (Amazon MX Player)
9. Inspector Avinash Season 2 — 9.2 million views (JioHotstar)
10. Raakh — 9 million views (Prime Video)

Prime Video's Quiet Dominance

The most striking takeaway is Amazon's commanding presence. Between Prime Video and Amazon MX Player, the company claimed six of the top 10 slots — including the number one spot. Matka King, the period drama about India's gambling underworld, pulled in 12.1 million views at fifth place, while TVF's Aspirants Season 3 continued its loyal following with 9.7 million views.

JioHotstar held strong with three entries. Divya Dutta's Chiraiya, a social drama tackling patriarchal oppression, landed at second with 16.3 million views — a number that underscores audience demand for socially conscious storytelling. Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar Season 2 and Inspector Avinash Season 2 rounded out JioHotstar's presence.

Netflix, once the undisputed leader of Indian streaming, managed just one scripted entry: Emraan Hashmi's crime thriller Taskaree at third place with 14.2 million views. The platform fared better in films — Dhurandhar led Bollywood OTT viewership at 35.2 million — but in the weekly series format, it has ceded significant ground.

The Samay Raina Factor

Beyond scripted content, the first half of 2026 belonged to one name: Samay Raina. His comedy show India's Got Latent Season 2, which premiered on Netflix after initially running on YouTube, recorded 38.5 million views — making it the single most-watched property across all OTT content in India, according to Ormax Media. His standalone special, Samay Raina: Still Alive, added another 13.1 million views.

"India's Got Latent Season 2 isn't even a month old on Netflix and it has already turned into the most-watched show or movie on OTT platforms in the year."

— MensXP, reporting on Ormax StreamView data

Raina's combined viewership of over 51 million dwarfed even Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar franchise, which had 35.2 million and 27.8 million views across its two parts. The comedian's return after a controversy-laden hiatus proved that audience loyalty can outweigh institutional caution.

What India's Viewing Habits Reveal

Several patterns emerge from the half-yearly data. Sequels and returning franchises dominate — five of the top 10 scripted entries are second or third seasons, suggesting platforms are investing in proven intellectual properties rather than risky originals. Biographical and socially relevant dramas performed exceptionally well, with the top two spots going to stories rooted in Indian experience rather than genre thrillers.

The international picture tells a different story. Among global shows watched in India, Amazon's college romance Off Campus topped the list, followed by The Boys Season 5. On Netflix's global charts, the mystery series His & Hers led all shows worldwide with 104 million views, followed by Bridgerton Season 4 at 100 million. Stranger Things 5, despite enormous anticipation, settled for fourth at 56 million views.

For Indian content creators and the diaspora audience following from abroad, the message is clear: homegrown stories with emotional depth are winning the streaming wars. The second half of 2026, with several major releases in the pipeline, will determine whether these trends hold or whether Netflix can mount a comeback in the scripted space it once dominated.
